title: CIP outright per tenor, simple money-market, per-ccy day count
deliverables: per-tenor table: tenor, days, t_base, t_quote, forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot S (quote per 1 base); deposit rates r_base, r_quote per tenor [K] in percent; days spot->delivery [K]; ccy codes. DITANYAKAN: outright forward F per tenor [K] in quote ccy per base. RUMUS: Core 1 F = S(1+r_Y t_Y)/(1+r_X t_X), t_c = days/basis_c; toolkit money_market_year_fraction, cip_forward(compounding='simple'). JAWAB: 1) parse pair -> base X, quote Y. 2) rates /100. 3) t_X, t_Y with each ccy basis (ACT/360 USD EUR JPY CHF; ACT/365 GBP AUD NZD CAD). 4) F per tenor. 5) check sign(F-S)=sign(r_Y-r_X); write.
formulas: F = S (1 + r_Y t_Y)/(1 + r_X t_X)
pitfalls: one day count for both ccys
t measured from trade date instead of spot date

title: CIP forward with continuous compounding
frame: DIKETAHUI: S (domestic per foreign); continuously compounded r_d, r_f; T in years per contract [M]. DITANYAKAN: F per contract [M] (domestic per foreign). RUMUS: Core 1 continuous F = S exp((r_d - r_f)T); toolkit cip_forward(compounding='continuous'). JAWAB: 1) identify domestic = quote ccy, foreign = base. 2) T from days/365 if given in days unless stated. 3) F = S e^{(r_d-r_f)T}. 4) check F>S iff r_d>r_f; write.
pitfalls: mixing simple deposit quotes into the exponential form

title: Forward points in pips from outright and spot
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot S and outright F per tenor [K]; pair labels. DITANYAKAN: points = F - S (quote units) and pips per tenor [K]. RUMUS: Core 1 points = F - S; pips = points*1e4 (1e2 JPY-terms); toolkit pip_multiplier, forward_points. JAWAB: 1) multiplier from pair (JPY quote -> 1e2, else 1e4). 2) points = F - S. 3) pips = points*multiplier. 4) label premium if positive (base at forward premium), discount if negative; write.
pitfalls: reporting quote units when pips are asked

title: JPY-terms pair forward points at 1e2
frame: DIKETAHUI: USD/JPY or X/JPY spot S, r_X, r_JPY (ACT/360 both), days [K]. DITANYAKAN: outright and forward pips [K] with JPY multiplier. RUMUS: Core 1; toolkit cip_forward, forward_points(pair='USDJPY') -> multiplier 100. JAWAB: 1) t = days/360 each. 2) F via CIP. 3) pips = (F-S)*100. 4) sign negative when r_JPY < r_X; write.
formulas: F = S (1 + r_JPY t)/(1 + r_X t)
pitfalls: JPY pips scaled by 1e4

title: Outright from quoted spot and forward points
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot bid/offer, forward points bid/offer in pips per tenor [K]; pair. DITANYAKAN: outright bid/offer [K]. RUMUS: Core 1 outright = spot + pips/multiplier; toolkit outright_from_points. JAWAB: 1) multiplier by pair. 2) outright_bid = spot_bid + bid_pips/mult; outright_offer = spot_offer + offer_pips/mult. 3) points quoted high/low (bid>offer) -> subtract (discount). 4) check outright_bid < outright_offer; write.
pitfalls: discount points (bid > offer) added instead of subtracted

title: Dealer bid/offer forward from spot sides and deposit sides
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot bid/offer; deposit bid/offer per ccy per tenor [K]; days; day counts. DITANYAKAN: forward bid and offer [K]; spread in pips. RUMUS: Core 2 F_bid = S_bid(1+r_Y,bid t_Y)/(1+r_X,offer t_X), F_offer = S_offer(1+r_Y,offer t_Y)/(1+r_X,bid t_X); toolkit cip_forward_bid_ask. JAWAB: 1) t per ccy. 2) bid side: borrow X at offer, lend Y at bid. 3) offer side mirrors. 4) spread = (F_offer-F_bid)*mult. 5) check spread >= spot spread; write.
pitfalls: pairing bid rate with bid spot on both ccys

title: Bid/offer forward with mid deposit rates only
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot bid/offer; single mid rate per ccy per tenor [K]. DITANYAKAN: forward bid/mid/offer [K]. RUMUS: Core 2 fallback: same CIP factor (1+r_Y t_Y)/(1+r_X t_X) applied to each spot side. JAWAB: 1) factor per tenor. 2) F_bid = S_bid*factor, F_offer = S_offer*factor, F_mid = S_mid*factor. 3) check bid<mid<offer; write.

title: Cross rate from two base-USD quotes (X/USD and Y/USD)
deliverables: table per cross: bid, offer, mid, spread
frame: DIKETAHUI: X/USD bid/offer and Y/USD bid/offer. DITANYAKAN: X/Y bid, offer, mid. RUMUS: Core 3 X/Y bid = XUSD_bid / YUSD_offer; offer = XUSD_offer / YUSD_bid; toolkit cross_rate. JAWAB: 1) orient both legs as ccy/USD. 2) divide with opposite sides. 3) mid = XUSD_mid/YUSD_mid. 4) check cross spread wider than each leg in relative terms; write.
pitfalls: dividing bid by bid

title: Cross rate from X/USD and USD/Y (multiply legs)
frame: DIKETAHUI: X/USD bid/offer and USD/Y bid/offer. DITANYAKAN: X/Y bid, offer, mid. RUMUS: Core 3 bid = XUSD_bid*USDY_bid, offer = XUSD_offer*USDY_offer; toolkit cross_rate. JAWAB: 1) confirm USD is quote of leg 1 and base of leg 2. 2) multiply same sides. 3) mid = product of mids. 4) check bid<offer; write.

title: Cross rate from two USD-base quotes (USD/X and USD/Y)
frame: DIKETAHUI: USD/X bid/offer, USD/Y bid/offer. DITANYAKAN: X/Y bid, offer, mid. RUMUS: Core 3 X/Y bid = USDY_bid/USDX_offer, offer = USDY_offer/USDX_bid; toolkit cross_rate. JAWAB: 1) X/Y = (Y per USD)/(X per USD). 2) opposite sides in the ratio. 3) mid ratio of mids. 4) check; write.
pitfalls: inverting the target (Y/X reported as X/Y)

title: Inverting a two-way FX quote
frame: DIKETAHUI: pair X/Y bid, offer [P]. DITANYAKAN: Y/X bid and offer [P]. RUMUS: Core 3 inverse = (1/offer, 1/bid); toolkit invert_quote. JAWAB: 1) new bid = 1/old offer. 2) new offer = 1/old bid. 3) relabel pair Y/X. 4) check bid<offer; write.
pitfalls: 1/bid used as new bid

title: Triangular arbitrage detection across three quoted pairs
deliverables: summary: implied cross bid/offer, arbitrage flag, profit per unit, direction
frame: DIKETAHUI: three pairs with bid/offer forming a loop (e.g. EUR/USD, USD/JPY, EUR/JPY); starting notional N. DITANYAKAN: whether a loop yields profit after spreads, and profit in start ccy. RUMUS: Core 3 synthetic cross from two legs vs direct quote; toolkit triangular_arbitrage(min_profit). JAWAB: 1) synthetic X/Y bid/offer from legs. 2) arbitrage if synthetic bid > direct offer (buy direct, sell synthetic) or direct bid > synthetic offer. 3) walk loop with dealer sides: product of conversion rates - 1. 4) profit = N*(loop-1); write.
formulas: loop = product of side-correct conversion rates
pitfalls: using mids so a profit appears inside the spread

title: Cross forward from two USD forwards
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot and forward (or rates) for X/USD and USD/Y per tenor [K]. DITANYAKAN: X/Y forward and points per tenor [K]. RUMUS: Core 1 per leg then Core 3 multiplication; equivalently CIP with r_X, r_Y directly. JAWAB: 1) leg forwards via CIP or points. 2) cross F = F_XUSD*F_USDY (or ratio by quote form). 3) cross spot likewise. 4) points = F-S with cross multiplier. 5) check vs direct CIP with r_X, r_Y; write.

title: Implied base-currency yield from spot and forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot S, forward F (or pips) per tenor [K], quote-ccy rate r_Y, days, bases. DITANYAKAN: implied base-ccy rate r_X [K]. RUMUS: Core 4 r_X = [(S/F)(1+r_Y t_Y) - 1]/t_X; toolkit implied_base_rate. JAWAB: 1) outright from pips if needed. 2) t_X, t_Y. 3) solve r_X. 4) output percent if asked; check plugging back reproduces F; write.
pitfalls: using trade-date year fraction

title: Implied quote-currency yield from FX swap points
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, F per tenor [K], base-ccy rate r_X (often USD), days, bases. DITANYAKAN: implied r_Y [K]. RUMUS: Core 4 r_Y = [(F/S)(1+r_X t_X) - 1]/t_Y; toolkit implied_quote_rate. JAWAB: 1) F from points. 2) t per ccy. 3) solve r_Y. 4) compare to observed r_Y -> basis in bps if asked; write.

title: Implied yields with dealer sides
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot mid (or sides), forward bid/offer [K], USD rate bid/offer [K]. DITANYAKAN: implied non-USD lending (bid) and borrowing (offer) rates [K]. RUMUS: Core 4 with side pairing: pair each F side with the opposite USD rate side as the task states. JAWAB: 1) decide which leg is synthetic borrowing vs lending. 2) bid implied = invert CIP with F_bid and the USD side that makes the trade executable. 3) offer likewise. 4) check implied bid < implied offer; write.
pitfalls: mid USD rate used for both sides

title: CIP deviation in bps per tenor
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, rates per ccy, days [K], market forwards [K]. DITANYAKAN: CIP deviation per tenor in bps (sign as specified). RUMUS: Core 5 dev = (F_mkt - F_cip)/F_cip*1e4; toolkit cip_forward, cip_deviation_bps. JAWAB: 1) F_cip per tenor. 2) dev bps. 3) annualise only if the task asks (divide by t). 4) check CIP-built forward -> 0; write.
pitfalls: sign convention reversed vs task statement

title: Cross-currency basis implied from market forward (simple)
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, market F [K], OIS/deposit rates per ccy [K], days, bases. DITANYAKAN: basis b on the non-USD leg in bps [K]. RUMUS: Core 5 F_mkt = S(1+r_Y t_Y)/(1+(r_X+b)t_X) solved for b; toolkit implied_basis(compounding='simple'). JAWAB: 1) identify which ccy carries the basis (non-USD). 2) solve b = [S(1+r_Y t_Y)/F_mkt - 1]/t_X - r_X (adapt when non-USD is quote). 3) bps = b*1e4. 4) sign: negative = USD via swap dearer; write.
pitfalls: basis attached to the USD leg

title: Cross-currency basis, continuous form
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, F_mkt, continuous r_d, r_f per tenor [K], tau. DITANYAKAN: annualised basis per tenor in bps [K]. RUMUS: Core 5 continuous b = ln(F_cip/F_mkt)/tau; F_cip = S e^{(r_d-r_f)tau}; toolkit implied_basis(compounding='continuous'). JAWAB: 1) F_cip. 2) b = ln(F_cip/F_mkt)/tau (sign as the text defines; DTV: x = r_USD - (r_loc - (ln F - ln S)/tau), S in local per USD). 3) *1e4. 4) check CIP-consistent forward gives 0; write.

title: Synthetic USD funding cost via FX swap vs USD OIS
deliverables: summary: synthetic USD rate, direct USD rate, premium bps
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, F per tenor, non-USD OIS rate, USD OIS rate, days. DITANYAKAN: synthetic USD borrowing rate and its premium over USD OIS in bps. RUMUS: Core 4 implied USD rate from swap: r_USD,syn = [(1+r_loc t)(S/F or F/S) - 1]/t by quote direction; premium = (r_syn - r_USD)*1e4. JAWAB: 1) borrow local, sell spot for USD, buy local forward. 2) implied USD rate. 3) premium = -basis approx. 4) write.

title: Broken-date forward by rate interpolation
deliverables: table per broken date: interpolated rates, forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, rate curves per ccy at tenor nodes [K] (days), target delivery days [J]. DITANYAKAN: forward per broken date [J]. RUMUS: Completing inputs: rates linear in days, flat before first node; then Core 1. JAWAB: 1) for each ccy np.interp(days_target, node_days, rates) with flat extrapolation. 2) t per ccy. 3) CIP forward. 4) check forward lies between bracketing tenor forwards in points; write.
pitfalls: interpolating in years with a different basis per ccy inconsistently

title: Broken-date forward by interpolating ln F or points
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, forward points or outrights at tenor nodes [K], node days, target days [J]. DITANYAKAN: outright and points per broken date [J]. RUMUS: Completing inputs: ln F linear in time from spot (ln S at day 0) through nodes; or points linear in days if stated. JAWAB: 1) node grid with (0, ln S). 2) interp ln F at target days. 3) F = exp. 4) points = F-S in pips; write.
formulas: ln F(d) linear in d with ln F(0) = ln S

title: Spot and delivery date rolling with joint calendar
deliverables: per-trade table: trade_date, spot_date, delivery_date, days
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade dates [M], pairs, holiday lists per ccy, tenors (n months/weeks). DITANYAKAN: spot date, delivery date and days spot->delivery [M]. RUMUS: Conventions: spot T+2 (USD/CAD T+1) on the joint calendar; delivery = spot + n months, Modified Following. JAWAB: 1) add business days skipping weekends and holidays of BOTH ccys. 2) add months to spot date. 3) adjust Modified Following (stay in month). 4) days = delivery - spot; write.
pitfalls: skipping only one calendar

title: Money-market year fractions per currency
frame: DIKETAHUI: days [K] and ccy list. DITANYAKAN: t per ccy per tenor [K x C]. RUMUS: Conventions: ACT/360 USD EUR JPY CHF SEK NOK DKK; ACT/365 GBP AUD NZD CAD; toolkit money_market_basis, money_market_year_fraction. JAWAB: 1) basis per ccy (override if task states). 2) t = days/basis. 3) write.

title: Forward MTM undiscounted per trade
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [M] (pair, direction, base notional N, contract rate K, maturity), current forwards for remaining tenor. DITANYAKAN: MTM per trade in quote ccy [M]. RUMUS: Core 6 V_Y = s*N*(F_t(T)-K), s=+1 buy base; toolkit forward_mtm, direction_sign. JAWAB: 1) sign from direction. 2) current forward for each trade maturity (interpolate). 3) V = s N (F-K). 4) sum per ccy; write.
pitfalls: sell sign not flipped

title: Forward MTM discounted and converted to USD
deliverables: per-trade table: mtm_quote, df, pv_quote, pv_usd
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [M], current forward F_t(T), quote-ccy discount rate/curve, spot rates to USD. DITANYAKAN: PV per trade in quote ccy and USD; total. RUMUS: Core 6 V = s N (F_t(T)-K) DF_Y(t,T); DF from simple or continuous rate as stated; toolkit forward_mtm, to_usd. JAWAB: 1) DF_Y per trade. 2) PV quote. 3) convert at spot (quote ccy -> USD; invert if pair is USD/Y). 4) total; check parts sum; write.
pitfalls: converting with the forward instead of spot

title: Forward PnL attribution: spot, carry, residual
deliverables: per-trade table: spot_pnl, carry_pnl, residual, total
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [M] (N, direction), S_then, S_now, F_then, F_now. DITANYAKAN: spot, carry, residual and total PnL per trade [M]. RUMUS: Core 6 spot = sN(S_now-S_then); carry = sN[(F_now-S_now)-(F_then-S_then)]; residual = total - spot - carry; toolkit forward_pnl_attribution. JAWAB: 1) total = sN(F_now-F_then) (or PV change). 2) components. 3) residual closes exactly. 4) check sum; write.

title: Net currency exposure from a forward book
deliverables: dict: one key per ccy, signed amount
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [M] (pair, direction, base notional, rate). DITANYAKAN: net amount per ccy (base +sN, quote -sNK). RUMUS: toolkit net_currency_exposure, parse_pair. JAWAB: 1) for each trade: base ccy += sN; quote ccy -= sNK. 2) group by ccy. 3) optional USD equivalent at spot. 4) write one key per ccy.

title: Spot stress on a forward book
frame: DIKETAHUI: forward book [M], spot, rates, shock sizes [Z] (relative). DITANYAKAN: stressed PV and PnL per scenario [Z]. RUMUS: Core 1 rebuild F from shocked spot with unchanged rates; Core 6 revalue; PnL = stressed PV - base PV. JAWAB: 1) base PV. 2) S' = S(1+shock). 3) F' via CIP, PV'. 4) PnL. 5) FX delta ~ sN DF_Y e... per unit; write.

title: FX swap near and far legs pricing
deliverables: per-swap table: near_rate, far_rate, swap_points, near/far amounts
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot bid/offer, far points bid/offer, near points (0 for spot-start), base notional N, direction. DITANYAKAN: near and far rates, quote amounts per leg. RUMUS: Core 7 same side on both legs chosen by the far leg; swap points = far - near. JAWAB: 1) client buys base far -> offer side of far points; near uses the same spot side. 2) near = spot + near_pts/mult; far = spot + far_pts/mult. 3) amounts N*rate. 4) write.
pitfalls: using bid on one leg and offer on the other

title: Rolling a maturing forward with an FX swap
deliverables: per-roll table: near_rate, far_rate, roll cash flow
frame: DIKETAHUI: maturing hedge (N, K, direction), spot at roll, new tenor points, rates. DITANYAKAN: cash settled at roll (quote ccy) and new forward rate. RUMUS: Core 7: near leg closes old hedge at spot, far leg sets new forward; cash = sN(S_roll - K). JAWAB: 1) near leg opposite to old hedge at spot. 2) far leg same direction as old hedge at spot + points. 3) realised cash. 4) next hedge rate stored; write.
pitfalls: rolling the hedge with the monthly basket

title: Forward hedge roll return over a history
deliverables: per-period table: forward premium, hedge return
frame: DIKETAHUI: monthly spot S_t and 1M forward F_t series [T] (USD per foreign or as stated). DITANYAKAN: per-period hedge PnL per unit and annualised hedge cost. RUMUS: Core 12: short-foreign forward hedge return = (F_{t-1} - S_t)/S_{t-1}; hedge cost ~ (F/S - 1). JAWAB: 1) align S_t with F_{t-1}. 2) hedge return per period. 3) annualise x12. 4) write.
pitfalls: using F_t with S_t (look-ahead)

title: NDF cash settlement amount
frame: DIKETAHUI: NDFs [M] USD/LOC with USD notional N, rate K, direction, fixing Fix. DITANYAKAN: USD settlement per NDF (sign to holder). RUMUS: Core 8 USD settlement = N (Fix - K)/Fix to the USD buyer. JAWAB: 1) sign s=+1 if long USD. 2) settle = s N (Fix-K)/Fix. 3) fixing date = settlement - 2 business days. 4) write.
pitfalls: settling in local ccy N(Fix-K) without dividing by Fix

title: NDF mark-to-market before fixing
frame: DIKETAHUI: NDFs [M], current offshore forward F to settlement, USD discount curve. DITANYAKAN: PV in USD per NDF. RUMUS: Core 8 expected settle = sN(F-K)/F; PV = that * DF_USD(settlement). JAWAB: 1) fixing and settlement dates. 2) F to fixing (interpolate). 3) PV. 4) write.

title: MTM resettable cross-currency swap cash flows
deliverables: per-period table: reset_fx, notional_nonusd, reset_flow, coupon, pv_usd
frame: DIKETAHUI: USD notional N_USD fixed, reset dates [P], FX fixings/forwards (USD per non-USD), floating rates, spread, accruals, USD OIS DFs. DITANYAKAN: per-period non-USD notional, reset flows, coupons, PV in USD. RUMUS: Core 9 N_i = N_USD / FX(reset_i); reset flow N_i - N_{i-1} at reset; final N_last; non-USD -> USD at FX forward; discount USD OIS. JAWAB: 1) initial N_0 = N_USD/spot_inception. 2) past resets use fixings, future use forwards. 3) coupons N_{i-1}(r_i+s)tau_i. 4) convert, discount. 5) exclude past flows; write.
pitfalls: reset sign flipped (flips FX delta)

title: Constant-notional cross-currency swap PV
frame: DIKETAHUI: two legs with notionals N_A, N_B, coupons/spread, schedules, discount curves per ccy (collateral-adjusted), spot. DITANYAKAN: PV of each leg and net swap PV in report ccy. RUMUS: PV_leg = sum c_i tau_i N DF_i + N DF_T (minus initial if forward-start); convert foreign leg at spot (or forward per flow then discount). JAWAB: 1) project floating rates. 2) PV each leg incl. principal. 3) convert. 4) net; check leg PVs sum; write.
formulas: PV = sum N c_i tau_i DF_i + N DF_T

title: Par cross-currency basis spread solve
frame: DIKETAHUI: swap schedule, notionals N_i, FX forwards, DFs, current contract spread s_c and PV. DITANYAKAN: par spread making PV=0, bps. RUMUS: Core 9 s = s_c - PV/(sum N_i tau_i FX_i DF_i) on the non-USD leg. JAWAB: 1) PV at s_c. 2) spread annuity in USD. 3) s_par. 4) recheck PV(s_par)=0; write in bps.
formulas: annuity = sum N_i tau_i FX_i DF_i
pitfalls: spread added to USD leg

title: Garman-Kohlhagen call/put price with parity check
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r_d, r_f, sigma per contract [M]. DITANYAKAN: call and put prices in domestic per foreign; parity residual. RUMUS: Core 10; toolkit garman_kohlhagen_price (equivalently bs_price with q=r_f). JAWAB: 1) T = days/365. 2) d1,d2. 3) C,P. 4) residual = C-P-(S e^{-r_f T}-K e^{-r_d T}) ~ 1e-10; write.
formulas: C = S e^{-r_f T}N(d1) - K e^{-r_d T}N(d2)
C - P = S e^{-r_f T} - K e^{-r_d T}
pitfalls: swapping r_d and r_f

title: FX option deltas: spot, forward, premium-adjusted
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r_d, r_f, sigma, kind per contract [M]; premium ccy. DITANYAKAN: deltas per convention [M]. RUMUS: Core 10 spot = e^{-r_f T}N(d1); fwd = N(d1); PA spot = e^{-r_f T}(K/F)N(d2); put PA = -e^{-r_f T}(K/F)N(-d2); toolkit bs_greeks(q=r_f). JAWAB: 1) F = S e^{(r_d-r_f)T}. 2) each delta. 3) pick reported one: PA if premium in base ccy. 4) check PA < spot delta for calls; write.
pitfalls: no e^{-r_f T} in spot delta

title: Strike from delta (25-delta call/put)
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, T, r_d, r_f, vol per pillar, target delta, delta type. DITANYAKAN: strike per pillar. RUMUS: Core 11 unadjusted closed form K = F exp(-+ N^{-1}(e^{r_f T}|D|) s sqrt T + s^2 T/2); PA delta needs brentq on K. JAWAB: 1) F. 2) unadjusted: closed form (call sign -, put +). 3) PA: brentq on PA-delta(K)=target, bracket near F. 4) check delta(K) reproduces target; write.
formulas: K = F exp(-N^{-1}(e^{r_f T} D) s sqrt T + s^2 T/2) (call)
pitfalls: PA call delta not monotone: bracket the right branch

title: ATM strike by convention
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, F per tenor, ATM vol, T, premium convention. DITANYAKAN: ATM strike per tenor. RUMUS: V3: DNS unadjusted K = F e^{s^2 T/2}; DNS premium-adjusted K = F e^{-s^2 T/2}; ATMF K=F; ATM spot K=S. JAWAB: 1) F. 2) choose convention (default DNS). 3) K. 4) check straddle delta = 0; write.

title: Smile vols from ATM, risk reversal and butterfly
frame: DIKETAHUI: ATM, RR25, BF25 per tenor [K] (vol points). DITANYAKAN: 25D call and put vols [K]. RUMUS: Core 11 s25C = ATM + BF + RR/2; s25P = ATM + BF - RR/2 (smile strangle, V4 default). JAWAB: 1) vol points -> decimals. 2) apply. 3) RR = s25C - s25P check. 4) strikes via delta inversion if asked; write.
pitfalls: broker market-strangle BF treated as smile BF

title: FX option premium unit conversions
deliverables: per-contract table: terms_pips, base_pct, terms_pct, base_pips
frame: DIKETAHUI: V in terms per base (from GK), S, K, notional. DITANYAKAN: premium in each unit convention. RUMUS: Clark: terms pips V; base % = V/S; terms % = V/K; base pips = V/(SK). JAWAB: 1) V from GK. 2) conversions. 3) amount = notional_base * V (terms ccy). 4) write.

title: Implied vol from FX option premium
frame: DIKETAHUI: premium V, S, K, T, r_d, r_f, kind [M]. DITANYAKAN: implied vol per contract. RUMUS: toolkit implied_vol(price, S, K, T, r=r_d, q=r_f). JAWAB: 1) convert premium to terms pips. 2) check bounds (intrinsic on forward). 3) solve. 4) reprice; write.
pitfalls: passing premium in base % without converting

title: FX option vega and gamma reporting
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r_d, r_f, sigma, notional [M]. DITANYAKAN: vega per 1 vol point and gamma per contract. RUMUS: Core 10 vega = S e^{-r_f T} phi(d1) sqrt T; gamma = e^{-r_f T}phi(d1)/(S s sqrt T); vega per 1% = vega/100; toolkit bs_greeks(q=r_f). JAWAB: 1) d1. 2) greeks per unit. 3) scale by notional. 4) write.
formulas: vega = S e^{-r_f T} phi(d1) sqrt T

title: Single-currency carry trade return for a USD investor
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot S_t (USD per foreign) [T], r_f and r_USD per period [T], days. DITANYAKAN: carry excess return per period and summary. RUMUS: Core 12 R = S_t/S_{t-1} - 1 + (r_f - r_USD)days/basis using rates known at t-1. JAWAB: 1) orient S as USD per foreign (invert if quoted foreign per USD). 2) rate diff from t-1. 3) R. 4) annualise; write.
pitfalls: inverted quote flips every sign

title: Carry portfolio long top-k short bottom-k with lag
deliverables: per-period table: longs, shorts, portfolio return
frame: DIKETAHUI: monthly rates per ccy [T x C] (forward-filled), spot per ccy [T x C], k. DITANYAKAN: monthly portfolio returns and summary. RUMUS: Core 12 per ccy; V5 lag: rank at t, hold over t+1; equal weights 1/k each leg. JAWAB: 1) ffill rates. 2) rank by r_f - r_USD at t. 3) long top-k, short bottom-k. 4) return over t+1 = mean(long R) - mean(short R). 5) annualise x12; check long leg = highest rates; write.
pitfalls: same-day signal and return (look-ahead)

title: Forward-hedged foreign asset return
deliverables: per-period table: local, unhedged, hedged returns
frame: DIKETAHUI: foreign asset local returns [T], spot S (home per foreign) [T], 1-period forwards F_{t-1} [T]. DITANYAKAN: unhedged and hedged home-ccy returns, optionally partial hedge h. RUMUS: Core 12 unhedged = (1+R_loc)(S_t/S_{t-1}) - 1; hedged ~ R_loc + (F_{t-1}/S_{t-1} - 1) (+ residual on unhedged return part). JAWAB: 1) align. 2) unhedged. 3) hedged with hedge notional set at t-1 (stale until roll). 4) h-weighted mix; write.

title: Carry portfolio VaR/CVaR and drawdown
deliverables: summary json: var, cvar, max_drawdown, skew
frame: DIKETAHUI: carry portfolio returns [T]; level alpha; sign convention. DITANYAKAN: historical VaR, CVaR, max drawdown, skewness. RUMUS: toolkit historical_var_es or var_es_historical, max_drawdown. JAWAB: 1) returns series. 2) quantile at 1-alpha (numpy linear unless stated). 3) CVaR = mean beyond. 4) sign per convention (loss positive). 5) check CVaR beyond VaR; write.
pitfalls: mixed sign convention between VaR and CVaR

title: UIP / Fama forward premium regression
deliverables: summary: alpha, beta, t-stat (beta=1 and beta=0), r2
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot s_t and forward f_t logs [T] monthly per ccy. DITANYAKAN: OLS of ds_{t+1} on (f_t - s_t); t-tests. RUMUS: ds_{t+1} = a + b(f_t - s_t) + e; UIP b=1; toolkit ols(hac_lags) for Newey-West. JAWAB: 1) logs, align t+1. 2) OLS with HAC. 3) t for H0 b=1: (b-1)/se. 4) write.
formulas: s_{t+1} - s_t = a + b (f_t - s_t) + e
pitfalls: overlapping horizons without HAC

title: Perpetual futures funding-rate carry
frame: DIKETAHUI: funding rates per 8h settlement [T], position notional, side. DITANYAKAN: funding PnL and annualised yield. RUMUS: Conventions: positive rate -> longs pay shorts; 3 settlements/day -> annualise x1095; 0.0001 = 1 bp. JAWAB: 1) sign: short perp receives +rate*notional. 2) sum PnL. 3) annualise mean*1095. 4) write.
pitfalls: annualising x365 with 3 settlements per day

title: Cash-and-carry crypto basis from futures
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot S, futures F per expiry [K], days to expiry. DITANYAKAN: basis F/S - 1 and annualised implied carry. RUMUS: simple ann = (F/S - 1)*365/days; continuous ln(F/S)/T; compare to funding rate. JAWAB: 1) days per expiry. 2) basis. 3) annualise per convention. 4) write.

title: Interest differential implied by forward points sign check
deliverables: per-tenor table: implied diff, sign check flag
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot, points per tenor [K], one ccy rate. DITANYAKAN: implied rate differential and whether sign(points)=sign(r_quote - r_base). RUMUS: Core 4 implied rate then diff; invariant sign(points) = sign(r_Y - r_X). JAWAB: 1) outright. 2) implied other rate. 3) diff. 4) flag mismatches (likely inverted quote); write.

title: Hedging a foreign receivable: forward vs money-market hedge
deliverables: summary: home amount forward hedge, home amount mm hedge, difference
frame: DIKETAHUI: foreign amount A due at T, spot S (home per foreign), forward F, r_home, r_foreign, days. DITANYAKAN: home-ccy proceeds under each hedge. RUMUS: forward: A*F; money market: borrow A/(1+r_f t_f) foreign, convert at S, invest at r_h: A S (1+r_h t_h)/(1+r_f t_f). JAWAB: 1) forward proceeds. 2) MM proceeds. 3) equal under CIP; difference = basis/spread effect. 4) write.
formulas: mm = A S (1 + r_h t_h)/(1 + r_f t_f)

title: Two-way swap points to outright forwards per tenor table
deliverables: per-tenor table: outright_bid, outright_mid, outright_offer, pips_mid
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot bid/offer; points bid/offer per tenor [K] (pips); pair. DITANYAKAN: outrights per tenor [K]. RUMUS: Core 1; toolkit outright_from_points. JAWAB: 1) mult. 2) detect premium (bid<offer) vs discount (bid>offer, subtract). 3) outrights by side; mid = average. 4) check spread widens with tenor; write.

title: FX forward exposure conversion to report currency with cross rates
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade PVs in various quote ccys [M], USD spot quotes per ccy. DITANYAKAN: PV in a chosen report ccy (not necessarily USD). RUMUS: Core 3 triangulate ccy -> USD -> report ccy with correct orientation; toolkit to_usd, cross_rate. JAWAB: 1) orient each USD quote. 2) convert each PV to USD. 3) USD -> report ccy. 4) sum; write.
formulas: PV_rep = PV_c * (USD per c)/(USD per rep)
pitfalls: dividing where multiplying is needed for USD/c quotes
